integrity: Complete finite face, acyclic Morse and exact integral boundary calculation with independent mod-two boundary check; source chronology based on first public arXiv records.
scientific_limitations: Finite result for ordinary four-cut complex of J(6,2) only; integral homology rather than full integral homotopy type; no statement on higher attaching maps or general J(n,2) family; unresolved possible unindexed equivalent literature.
title: Two separated integral homology degrees in the four-cut complex of the triangular graph on six points
